name: Investment and tax
summary: CAGR and ROI, break-even, inflation and India income tax
author: friday-core
description: Money questions about returns, costs and tax. It holds 4 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. CAGR and ROI: Yearly growth rate and total return between two values. Break-even: Units and revenue to cover fixed costs, and profit at a planned volume. Inflation: Future cost and present worth of an amount at an inflation rate. India income tax: Estimate for an individual: new regime FY 2025-26 with rebate and marginal relief, and the old regime.
